title: GrainScanRecord
description: Grain -> RepairOS: the stored scan record returned by POST /projects/{id}/scans?name=&units= (body = the file), GET .../scans/{sid}, and photo uploads (which return the record plus photos[]). Pinned against the private recorded Grain fixtures (private/grain/observed/), plus target fields marked x-target. Grain makes the id; name is only a label and must end in the format's extension (else 400). bbox_mm and centroid_mm are in the design frame's units (mm) after Grain applies `units` (an upload with units=m is multiplied by 1000). A photo-only record (POST /projects/{id}/photos) has kind 'photos', file and units null, points 0 and no bbox. Grain owns the shape: additionalProperties allowed.

name.description: The label from the upload query, e.g. scan_7f3a.ply.

kind.description: 'photos' for a photo-only record; absent for a scan.

file.description: Stored file name; null for a photo-only record.

units.description: As declared at upload; never guessed.

points.description: Points stored (a mesh upload is sampled to points).

photos.description: Photos attached to this record (<= 8), stored downsized (px is the stored size).

frame.description: Target T9: echo of the upload's frame=design|world.

gravity.description: Target T9: echo of the upload's gravity=x,y,z (unit vector, down).

n.description: 1-based index on the record; with the record id it names the photo (target T5: {record, n} in /call).

name.description: The label from the upload; the only metadata a photo has today.

parts.description: Target T5: Grain part names the photo shows (diagnose parts[].name).

harness.description: Target T5: harness wire names in view.

box_px.description: Target T5: [x0, y0, x1, y1] crop box in the original image.

camera.description: Target T5: camera pose and intrinsics. position_m and quaternion_xyzw are in the frame the scan was uploaded in.
